scope.performed: Read and compare the received JSON/text proof files and hash referenced PNG captures. No browser control. This reception audit does not modify game or Bible files.
scope.operator: Root supplied the Chrome-export classifications and action observations. This agent independently verifies the files, hashes and exact state comparisons.
scope.comparison: Strict parsed-JSON equality for every nested value, array element and key; object key order is irrelevant. No numeric tolerance. Raw-byte equality is reported separately.
scope.revisionRule: Only the top-level /revision is excluded in the explicitly named comparison. Checkpoint comparisons exclude no fields.
scope.transitionReports: Movement/braking transitions compare all fields and record every changed JSON Pointer. Their expected inequality is distinct from reload preservation.
scope.checksum: sha256 is the original file bytes; canonicalJsonSha256 sorts object keys recursively while preserving array order and JSON numbers.

operatorReport.boundary: Reported browser actions and environment remain the operator’s observations. This audit independently verifies file identities and serialized state, not the historical UI actions themselves.

checks.operatorObservation: Native movement and three shots, then pause/export/reload/export. Movement was reported by root; the audit verifies the serialized state and its preservation.

rejectionMessage.source: Reported by the browser operator (root); the audit independently compares the preserved exports.

checks.scope: Import/export preservation of a prepared historical completion, not a new native full MI01 victory.

checks.operatorActions: Native MI02 unlock/briefing/launch and movement; then announced import of the Node chase input. Resume and D for about 1.6 s, pause/export/reload/export/resume, E and anchoring for about 4.5 s.
checks.boundary: The two harpoons were already released in the prepared input. The audit does not describe MI02 as entirely played natively, and the eight workers remain unrescued at the brake checkpoint.

checks.preciseScope: The geometric partial opening is preserved exactly. The native BEFORE-reload export already has working=false and progress=0. It is not evidence of an active work timer being restored: the Node input had working=true/progress≈0.35119, and work had stopped before this pause.

checks.operatorProvenance: Root reports native continuation from native-gate-input through completion, with no further import. The earlier campaign and pre-gate MI08 actions were prepared inputs; this is not a full native campaign or MI08 playthrough.
checks.focusIncident: The final movement passed through the unresolved QA19 tab-focus attempt. Completion is recorded as an observed outcome, not as proof that focus-loss pausing works.

archiveProof.classification: Chrome accessibility text reported by root; machine-checked text counts, not a visual or human usability review.

console.boundary: No application-origin entry appears in the supplied capture. This does not claim the absence of events outside the capture interval.

trials.reportedAction: Sky.click({x:620,y:20,key:'d'}) from running MI08 to about:blank, then a Sky.click back on the game tab.
trials.reportedOutcome: No pause dialog was observed on return; movement continued through extraction and MI08 completion.

trials.source: Re-import of the actual Chrome mi08-transmitted export for a separate focus probe after the main continuation.
trials.reportedAction: Native Resume click, then Sky.click on the address bar with key:'d'.
trials.reportedOutcome: Visible game timer moved from 05:11 to 05:17 while walking, then to a 05:28 result while the URL bar retained apparent focus.
trials.additionalImportBoundary: This replayed focus probe is separate from the first gate-to-completion journey. It does not change the stated no-further-import boundary of that first journey.

unresolvedNativeObservations.cause: Undetermined: tool focus behavior or application behavior has not been isolated.
unresolvedNativeObservations.proxyLimitation: The protected DOM read of document.hasFocus raised a proxy TypeError. This is not evidence of the real focus state or of an application error.
unresolvedNativeObservations.effectOnClaims: QA19 is not validated. Successful JSON preservation or MI08 completion does not override this unresolved focus observation.
unresolvedNativeObservations.provenance: Browser operator/root report; this agent did not perform the interaction.
